summary: Iteration 9 — Go-Live Roadmap dashboard card + WorkerDeploy auto-smoke transition. Backend: 17/17 pytest (5 live-readiness shape/blocking/worker-not-ok/auth/viewer + 2 worker probe + 2 worker smoke + 8 core regression). Frontend Playwright (admin + viewer): roadmap card renders only for admin when readiness.ready=false; 60% progress pill, progress bar width=60%, all 5 roadmap-step-{id} rows (trade_key/telegram/fast_alert/paper_track/worker), check icons for ok=true (trade_key, fast_alert, paper_track) and X icons + CTAs for ok=false (telegram, worker). roadmap-cta-worker links to /worker, roadmap-cta-telegram links to /telegram (verified via href). issues: Pre-existing React Router v6 future-flag warnings (harmless)
Cosmetic 401 from /api/auth/me probe before login completes — expected during auth handshake

critical_code_review_comments: /api/safety/live-readiness uses get_current_user, NOT require_admin. The review_request description claims 'admin-only', but currently any authenticated user (incl. viewer) can call it. Frontend gates the card with isAdmin so the UX is correct, but if the intent is server-side admin enforcement, change Depends(get_current_user) → Depends(require_admin) on line 1647 of server.py. Documented in test_viewer_access which accepts either 200 or 403.
server.py is now 1704 lines — still strongly recommend modularization into routers/{auth,bot,autopilot,worker,safety,alerts,users}.py. Same recommendation as iter7/iter8.
Dashboard.jsx now 372 lines with GoLiveRoadmap inline — clean for now but consider splitting GoLiveRoadmap + ROADMAP_ACTIONS map into /components/GoLiveRoadmap.jsx if it grows.

WorkerDeploy.jsx auto-smoke uses local component state (lastOkSeen). It correctly resets on offline→online transition, but if the user navigates away and back, lastOkSeen resets to false → will re-trigger smoke on next health probe even if it had already fired in a prior session. Likely fine for this UX but worth noting.

Polling interval on Dashboard is 2500ms — /safety/live-readiness runs a mongo aggregate every 2.5s while admin viewer has the dashboard open. Light per-call but consider lengthening readiness poll to 10–15s (independent from bot status poll) to reduce DB load.
